name: Neural Light Fields with Ray-Space Embedding
definition: A neural light field representation that maps 4D ray-space directly to integrated radiance, using a ray-space embedding network to re-map input ray-space into an intermediate, interpolable latent space to facilitate registration of rays observing same 3D points and interpolation of unobserved rays.
summary: Neural Light Fields with Ray-Space Embedding is a fast view synthesis method that maps 4D ray parameters to radiance via an embedding network, enabling single-evaluation rendering without volumetric integration.
